class.name: forward_command_controller/ForwardCommandController
class.description: Forward command controller for a group of joints. Subscribes to ~/commands (Float64MultiArray) for position-only multi-joint control, and ~/single_joint_command (JointCommand) for single-joint position+duration control.

class.name: forward_command_controller/MultiInterfaceForwardCommandController
class.description: Multi-interface forward controller for synchronized multi-joint position+duration control. Subscribes to ~/multi_joint_command (JointGroupCommand) with per-joint position_rad and duration_ms.
